content.text:
=== titles ===
8082: <title>Liquio Admin</title>
8081: <title>Liquio Cabinet</title>
8080: <title></title>
=== certs ===
    friendlyName: Admin Liquio
subject=O = Liquio, serialNumber = 0000000001, GN = Admin, SN = Liquio, CN = Admin Liquio
---demo---
    friendlyName: Demo Liquio
subject=O = Liquio, serialNumber = 3123456789, GN = Demo, SN = Liquio, CN = Demo Liquio

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== titles ==="; for p in 8082 8081 8080; do echo -n "$p: "; curl -s --max-time 10 http://localhost:$p/ | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' | head -1; done; echo "=== certs ==="; openssl pkcs12 -in config/admin.p12 -passin pass:admin -nokeys 2>&1 | grep -E 'subject|friendlyName' | head; echo "---demo---"; openssl pkcs12 -in config/demo.p12 -passin pass:demo -nokeys 2>&1 | grep -E 'subject|friendlyName' | head
